description: Admins only, not as an agent: set how unanswered delegations to humans are followed up. All fields optional: wichtig_ab (0-100), eskalation (name or user_id of the escalation person, empty = none), samstag, tagesuebersicht, aktiv. Reminders and the overview appear at the bell and in the delegation inbox on the website and in the app — never by mail or WhatsApp.

eskalation.description: Name or user_id; empty string = no escalation.

samstag.description: Whether follow-up also happens on Saturdays

tagesuebersicht.description: Whether a daily overview of open delegations is shown

wichtig_ab.description: Importance (0-100) from which a delegation counts as important for follow-up

name: set_user_delegation_settings
